symptom: Static FLF clips S03_01 and S02_04: framing inflates/undulates mid-take (Ken Burns zoom) even though first=last PNG and prompt said static camera
root_cause: H3 FLF interpolates a path A to B. When A=B it still invents a mid journey; character CUs default to push-in then rubber-band back. Word breathing maps to camera breathing. Pack negatives (zoom punch-in) never reach generate_minimax_h3 (no --negative).
fix: Do not use FLF when first equals last. Use I2V. Prompt must start: locked tripod, no zoom, no dolly, no push-in, framing stays identical. Never say breathing for camera-lock shots. Put no-zoom in the positive string.
prevention: Static/micro hold: task=i2v only. FLF only when last frame is a different composition. QA: t00 vs t50 scale must stay ~1.00; if subject grows, FAIL. H3 has no negative flag.
